tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: :bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar las: 'chi med tshe lha yongs rdzogs kyi tshe'i phyi sgrub bzhugs so:

rgya gar skad du: ā yur+dz+nyā na no pi ka nā ma: bod skad du: 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa zhes bya ba: 'chi med tshe'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas ston pas bka' bstsal pa: nyon cig gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin: 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub 'dod na: bcud len tshe yi sgrub pa bstan: tshe bdag chen po he ru ka: bla med gsang sgrub khyad par can: tshe dbang rig 'dzin mchog sgrub pa: bdud rtsi shel gyi bum sgrub bshad: de yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo: sngon du bsod nams tshogs chen bsags: dngos gzhi bcud len tshul du 'am: rgyas par sgrub chen khog nas dbyung: de yang tshe dbang bcud len rdzas: 'byung ba cha snyoms 'di lta ste: rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum bdud rtsi bzhi: 'di spyad yon tan bsam mi khyab: tshe bdag rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub: de phyir legs sbyar sgrub na mchog: rgyu gnyis rigs lnga yab yum gyi: byang sems cong zhi brag zhun yin: cong zhi bzang rigs bre gang dang: brag zhun bzang po phul gang gsog: rkyen gsum rtsi mar srang sum cu: sbrang rtsi bre do bur bre gsum: bcud bkrag stobs kyi gsos yin gsag: 'chi med bdud rtsi rnam bzhi ni: shug pa ba lu mkhan pa mtshe: 'dab ma me tog bcud du gsag: de rnams sman mar legs sbyar nas: zos na tshe ring nad dkon te: khyad par tshe dbang mchog 'dod na: gsang ba sgrub chen pho brang dbus: lcags par tshwa la med pa ru: sman rigs lha grangs mnyam byas bsgrub: par bu'i kha bsdams gzungs thag btag: dar ser gur phub gu gul bdug: bsnyen sgrub chog sgrig sgrub chen ltar: tshe dbang 'phro 'du'i bsnyen pa ni: rtsa sngags sham bur 'di nyid bzla: oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: āḥbh+rūm̐: oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐: rat+na mu tra ā yur+dz+nyā na hūm̐ hrīḥthā: de nas sgrub pa'i sngags 'di bzla: badz+ra satwa hūm̐: bai ro tsa na oṃ: rat+na mu tra trāṃ: a mi dhe wa hrī:

karma badz+ra hā: de nas las sbyor 'chi med sngags: 'di nyid bzlas shing dngos grub blang: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī ba hrī: sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa āṃ: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭha oṃ: grub rtags 'od dang du ba sgra: dri zhim yid du 'ong ba 'byung: bar skabs kun tu drang srong rnams: spyan drangs tshe yi gsol ba btab: de nas rang gzhan dbang bskur ba: bdud rtsi bum pa spyi bor bzhag: rtsa sngags rigs lnga'i snying por bcas: brjod cing rim gyis gnas lngar bskur: bdud rtsis lus gang rdo rjer bsam: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza: a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: sman phud drang srong lha mchod de: 'ju stob bya zhing rgyun du bza': zas ngan bsrung zhing bcud kyang gtang: mkhas shing man ngag ldan par gces: tshe dbang phun tshogs 'di bsgrubs pas: sman bcud yon tan bsam mi khyab: rgyu gnyis sman gyis sha rus rgyas: rkyen gsum stobs bcud bkrag kyang 'phel: rtsi bzhis tshe ring 'byung ba snyoms: rtsal ni seng ge stobs glang po: mdangs ni rma bya yang rtsal khyung: gsung ni tshangs pa bang ni rta: 'gro ba dbang 'dus sde brgyad khol: tshe dbang phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin 'grub: ces gsungs so: 'chi med tshe'i phyi sgrub rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ sgrub chen bka' brgyad las tshe'i nang sgrub bzhugs so: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: o rgyan pad+ma bdag nyid kyis: tshe sgrub zab mo brgya stong las: tshegs chung don che'i man ngag bsdus: yang zab 'grub myur don 'dril ba: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: dam chos sgrub pa'i gang zag gi: tshe yi bar chad bsal ba'i phyir: sgrub pa 'di la 'jug par gyis: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid ni: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: zhabs gnyis skyil krung rgyab yol can: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs:

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: 'od 'phros bde gshegs thams cad kyi: tshe yi dngos grub thams cad bsdus: rang gi lus la thim par bsam: tshe yi snying po 'di nyid bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza: sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhag re la ni brgya brgyad bzlas: de ltar rgyun du bzlas gyur na: 'das tshe nub phyogs bde ba can: 'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar skye: 'di la the tshom yod re kan: mi bstan snying gi dkyil du bcang: de nas dmigs pa 'di bsgom ste: rang gi snying gi dkyil du ni: tshe yi bdag po shel 'dra ba: yab yum sbyor ba byas pa yis: dwangs ma dkar dmar rgyun babs nas: snying dkyil lus ni gang ba yis: tshe dang bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsam: rjes su mi dmigs rgya yis gdab: zhag re thun res nges par chog: nad gdon tshe yi bar chad ni: dus gsum kun tu 'byung mi 'gyur: dus min tshe yi bar chad ni: 'byung ba'i dwangs ma 'khrugs pa yis: tshe yi bar chad byed pa yin: des na dmigs pa 'di bsgom na: rgyun du 'byung ba mi 'khrugs pas: lo brgya'i bar du 'chi mi 'gyur: bskal pa dus kyi tha ma la: mi rnams tshe thung snying rus chung: de dus tshegs chung sgrub sla myur: tshe sgrub kun gyi don bsdus nas: bdag 'dra pad+mas gter du sbas: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum chung zhes bya ba rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ sgrub chen bka' brgyad las tshe sgrub hrīḥgacig ma bzhugs so: rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang dbang lung man ngag rdzogs: dad brtson shes rab snying rjer ldan: skal bar ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas: gnas la nges med gang yang rung: dus la nges med nam yang rung: lus gnad nges med gang bde bya: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed snying rje bsgom: skad cig dran rdzogs hrīḥdamar las:

rang nyid pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: pad+ma'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs: phyag gnyis bdud rtsi'i thod pa 'dzin: za 'og ber dmar sku la gsol: thor tshugs dbu rgyan cod pan can: zhal 'dzum zhi ma khros par bsam: thugs kar pad+ma 'dab bzhi yi: lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus: hrīḥdamar tsheg drag ldan par bsgom: rang lus bla mar gsal ba yis: skad cig ma la kun gsal bstan: snang srid dkyil 'khor lhun grub yin: hrīḥdamar grangs med ci nus bzla: ma yengs zhag bdun hrīḥbasgrang na: ye shes mkha' 'gro dngos su 'du: 'chi nges pa yang lo brgya thub: lus sems bde gsal gri lce bde: dgos 'dod longs spyod char du 'beb: rang lus snang stong bla mar gyur: pad+ma thod phreng dngos su mthong: rang ngag dam chos dngos su 'char: mi dge sdig sgrib kun dang bral: dus gsum sangs rgyas sems las rnyed: rang sems chos skur blo thag chod: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob: 'byung bzhi'i sgyu lus ma spangs par: mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur: rig 'dzin tshe'i gsang sgrub rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ sgrub chen bka' brgyad las yang gsang nam mkha'i rdo rje bzhugs so: mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: yang gsang nam mkha'i rdo rje sgrub pa ni: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon song nas: rang nyid rta mgrin bsgoms nas ni: de yi snying po ci nus bzla: de yi thugs kar tshe dpag med: dmar gsal rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: skyil krung mnyam gzhag tshe bum bsnams: de yi thugs kar thig le'i mdog: 'od lnga'i zer dang bcas pa bsgom: srung ba'i sngags 'di bzla bar bya: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: āḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ka wa tsi hūm̐: de ni srung ba'i go cha 'o: dngos gzhi rang lus lte ba ru:

raṃ las me 'bar nad gdon dang: sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad bsregs: de nas rlung ni lan gsum 'bud: rang nyid sangs rgyas tshe dpag med: sku mdog dkar po rin chen brgyan: skyil krung mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: de ltar gsal bar bsgoms nas ni: kha gdangs shes rig nam mkhar gtad: kha sna gnyis nas nam mkha' rngubs: khams gsum 'jig rten thams cad kun: bdag gi khong du sib sib rngub: bdud rtsis mer mer gang bsam zhing: ting 'dzin gsal bas mchil ma mid: de dus sgregs pa 'byung ba yin: thun res nyin re'i 'chi ba bslu: 'di ni nam mkha'i bcud len te: ting 'dzin zas rnyed tshe la dbang: nad 'joms sgrib pa dag par 'gyur: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi ltas kun: 'di yis nges par slus 'gyur te: de phyir 'di la nan tan bya: tho rangs dus dang dgong mo bya: tshe ni nyi zla lta bur 'gyur: rjes su bsngo ba 'di ltar bya: bdag gi tshe la bar chad med par gyur cig: 'chi bdag gi bdud las thar bar gyur cig: tshe yongs su smin cing 'phel bar gyur cig: tshe rgyas par gyur cig: tshe'i bsam pa mthar phyin par gyur cig: tshe mthar phyin pa'i lus des kyang: 'gro don dpag tu med par byed nus par gyur cig: mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las thar nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig: 'di bya ba'i dus ni lto ma zos pa'i gong du bya'o: dgong mo zas rnying pa zhu: gsar pa ma zos pa'i dus su bya'o: tshe sgrub thams cad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa: sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhal gdams: o rgyan pad+ma'i bka' rgya dam pa 'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar las sgrub pa chen po dang 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub yongs rdzogs bzhugs so: bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: skal ldan gang zhig tshe sgrub par 'dod pas: tshe bum tshe rdzas thams cad spyi dang mthun par bsham:

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bgegs bskrad la sogs spyi dang mthun: de nas de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal stong 'dzin med ngang las: ma rtogs pa rnams snying rjes khyab pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin: rang rig rtsal du hūm̐ babs pas: hūm̐ las e yaṃ raṃ baṃ sum bh+rūm̐: de dag las 'byung ba lnga rim brtsegs su bskyed pa'i ri rab kyi steng du dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi pa sgo khyud can: seng ge glang chen khyung rma bya nyi zla'i steng du: tshe bdag rdo rje 'chang rigs lnga yab yum bsgom: de'i thugs kar sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal: snying po ni sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i snying po hūm̐ bsgrangs te bsnyen pa'o: thugs ye shes sems dpa' hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig bum pa'i nang du spros pas: de la ā yuḥ'abru brgyad kyis bskor bar bsam: gzungs thag 'then la spro bsdu byas pas: sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyu 'dra bas tshe'i rang bzhin nṛ mang po snod bcud kyi 'jig rten nas bkug ste bum pa khengs par bsam: de nas bdag tshe bdag rdo rje 'chang 'od dpag med du bsam: 'khor rgyal ba rigs bzhi yum lnga dang bcas pa sgo ma bzhi gsal bar bskyed: tshe dpag med yab yum rnams phyag g.yas rdo rje tshe dar rigs lnga bsnams pa: g.yon thams cad bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa: yum rnams tshe dar dang bum pa'o: sgo ma bzhi lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'o: de ltar gsal bas gzungs thag 'then nas: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: swā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: āṃḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: hā bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: de rnams re re la brgya rtsa re re bzla'o: hūm̐ gi bsnyen pa byas nas 'bru brgyad kyi pho nya btang: 'bru lngas sgrub chen du rig par bya'o: de nas tshe yi pho nya bskul te:

hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku ni nam mkha'i rdul bag med: phyag g.yas rdo rje tshe dar bsnams: g.yon pas rin chen bum pa 'dzin: yang gsang thugs kyi ga 'u nas: snying po thugs kyi ā yuḥ'adi: mgon po tshe bzhag gnas 'di yin: bdag cag tshe 'di gnas par mdzod: ces bskul bas yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas snying po tshe'i 'od zer 'phros pas lo ka'i zhing khams khengs par bsam: hūm̐: shar phyogs gangs ri dkar po'i gzhal yas nas: dkar mo mgyogs ma bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa dkar mo 'bum: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs bai ḍūr+yayi gzhal yas nas: sngon mo mgyogs ma bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa sngon mo 'bum: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐: nub phyogs pad+ma rā ga'i gzhal yas nas: dmar mo mgyogs ma bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa dmar mo 'bum: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐: byang phyogs in+d+ra nī la'i zhing khams nas: ljang mo mgyogs ma bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa ljang mo 'bum: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: de nas phyag rgya bca' zhing bskul te: hūm̐: khams gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu can: phyag na bse yi ga 'u bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: hūm̐: dus gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje zhags pa ma: phyag na rin chen zhags pa bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: hūm̐: srid gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje lcags sgrog ma: phyag na pad+ma bhan+ha bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: hūm̐: sku gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje dril bu ma: phyag na g.yu yi bum pa bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig:

hūm̐: mgyogs ma rnams kyis tshe drongs la: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig: gsang ba bzhi yis rgyas thob la: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig: oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: ā yu ṣe dz+nyā na dzaḥdza: zhes brjod pas 'khor 'das thams cad kyi tshe yi dngos grub bsdus nas bdag la thim par bsam mo: de nas tshe bstim zhing sba ba ni: hūm̐: nam mkha'i dbyings nas tshe 'gugs ma: bde gshegs yum ste kun tu bzang: rin chen gser gyi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni: 'khor lo 'bar bas rgyas thob cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: rdo rje'i yum chen sangs rgyas spyan: rin chen shel gyi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang bdud rtsis= rdo rje 'bar= tshe 'di bcol= hūm̐: lho yi phyogs= rin chen yum chen mā ma kī: rin chen mthing gi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyis bkang nas ni: rin chen 'bar bas= tshe 'di bcol= hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs= pad+ma'i yum chen na bza' dkar: pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyis bkang nas ni: pad+ma 'bar bas= tshe 'di= hūm̐: byang gi phyogs= las rab yum chen dam tshig sgrol: in+d+ra nī la'i bum pa bsnams: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni: rgya gram 'bar bas rgyas thob cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: de nas tshe brtan par bya ste: hūm̐ tra tra shag mu tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: snying po bskyod par mi nus te: rdo rje 'chang gi tshe yang tshe: spros pas khams gsum bkrag dang ldan: bsdus pas lus la gzi mdangs 'bar: bcings pas rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud: brtan pas mi 'gyur rdo rje 'dra: skal ldan rdo rje dam tshig can: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub stsol: tshe mchog rdo rje hūm̐ rtogs shog: ces rnal 'byor pa rig mar bcas pas mgo la tshe bum bzhag ste: spyi bo dpral ba ltag pa rna ltag g.yon du tshe bum bzhag la:

oṃ badz+ra ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ bud+dha ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: swā rat+na ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: oṃ pad+ma ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: hā karma ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas tshe yi bkra shis brjod pa ni: oṃ: sku yi sku ste sku la thim: phung po lnga la rab tu thim: ā: gsung gi gsung ste gsung la thim: ljags kyi dbang po mchog la thim: hūm̐: thugs kyi thugs te thugs la thim: rang byung thugs la rab tu thim: nyin la bkra shis mtshan bkra shis: nyin mtshan rgyun du bkra shis pa: skal ldan rnams la bkra shis shog: nyi ma'i snying po gsal gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dz+nyā na hūm̐ he: zhes tshe bstim zhing dbang bskur ro: 'di ni rgyun du tshe sgrub yi dam du bya'o: sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i dus su yang 'di'i tshe 'gugs bya'o: tshe sgrub yongs rdzogs rdzogs so: ༈ bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar las tshe'i pra brtag bzhugs so: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'chi med pra brtag gsal ba'i me long ni: pra brtag shin tu mang na yang: khyad par tshe zan la brtag pa ni: mdun nas gas na rang la ngan: g.yas nas gas na pho phyogs la ngan: g.yon nas gas na mo phyogs la ngan: rgyab nas gas na 'khor la ngan: mtshams bzhir gas na nor la ngan: kha rgyan chag na dgra rkun sdang: tshe ril brul na sris la ngan: mgul na gas na dngos grub med: rdo rje gas na chung sri langs: nyi zla gas na rkyen ngan yong: yo zhing gas na rims nad yong: phung po zhig na mthu gtad yin: tshe zan 'gyel na blon la ngan:

slob dpon zer ba'ang 'dug / de ni tshe zan ngan rtags so: bzang po brtag pa 'di ltar ro: bum par 'od byung tshe chu lud: tshe gtor brtan cing skyon med dang: tshe 'bras 'dus dang sgul skyod med: mar me dwangs shing mar khu sme: dkyil 'khor bkrag cing snum mdog ldan: nyams dang mngon shes ldan pa dang: dri bzang ngad pa skad snyan 'byung: nam mkhar sgra 'byin 'ja' tshon 'khyil: rtags bzang de rnams byung ba na: tshe yi dngos grub 'dus pa'i rtags: de yi dbang bskur thob pa na: rkyen dang bar chad ma lus sel: tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs: dpal dang 'byor pa ldan pa yin: pra brtag bsdus pa : sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
